title: Speaking Part 4 — a view, developed
note: Six chapters of five questions. Each card: Candidate A reacts, gives a view and develops it — always widening it out to people in general — then the examiner turns to Candidate B, who refers to A by name and adds one point. Three pairs: Beatriz & Tomás, Rodrigo & Inês, Leonor & Diogo. Built by build-part4.py.
tip: Part 1 asks about you. Part 4 asks about people. Give your view — then widen it out.
